::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 10th [1854]  
**From:** Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Michigan State University
:::

Dear [Sir](people/person_1143.qmd),
My new tale of ‘[Heartsease or The Brother's Wife](cmy_books/cmybook_19.qmd)’ is now complete. I am willing to publish it in the same manner as the ‘[Heir of Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_13.qmd)’ and if you are ready to undertake it, will forward it to you, as soon as I have heard from you. At your convenience, I should be glad to know the state of the account of [The Little Duke](cmy_books/cmybook_20.qmd).

Yours faithfully,
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
